summary: Vicore Pharma filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Rob Slack as Chief Scientific Officer, effective July 6, 2026, succeeding Johan Raud who transitions to Senior Advisor. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are disclosed. The filing is routine executive succession, not a forced departure, with no M&A or special situation context. The non-US filing is reported as a foreign private issuer update under Rule 13a-16. Watch for any impact on pipeline development, but no risk-arb angle applies.
